title: Native 9:16 render of the launch film
caption: The Magnifito launch film rendered again from the same brief, plan and brand at 1080x1920 with render --format 9:16. Nothing is cropped: HyperFrames lays each card out for the tall frame, so the lines re-flow and the logo and icons stay whole.
prompt: Use the magnifito-variants skill to make a native vertical 9:16 version of the Magnifito launch film (showcase/01-branded-promo) for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Do not crop the 16:9 master: copy its brief, plan, brand, claims and assets here, render the four brand-title cards transparent at 1080x1920 with HyperFrames, and composite them over the same slow cream backdrop with the dot grid, rise-in transitions, whooshes on the cuts and the chime on the end card, laid out for the tall frame.
commands: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=180x320:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.28*W+0.10*W*sin(T*0.5)),2)+pow(Y-(0.80*H+0.10*H*cos(T*0.4)),2))/(2*pow(0.42*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=180x320:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.80*W+0.08*W*cos(T*0.35)),2)+pow(Y-(0.18*H+0.08*H*sin(T*0.45)),2))/(2*pow(0.48*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=0xf0eadf:s=180x320:r=30:d=15" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=1080x1920:r=30:d=0.04" -filter_complex "[0]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.11:gg=0.15:bb=0.18[g1];[1]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.05:gg=0.07:bb=0.08[g2];[2]format=gbrp[base];[base][g1]blend=all_mode=subtract[m];[m][g2]blend=all_mode=subtract,scale=1080:1920:flags=bicubic[soft];[3]format=gray,geq=lum='255*clip(1.9-hypot(mod(X,40)-20,mod(Y,40)-20),0,1)',loop=loop=-1:size=1,trim=duration=15,setpts=N/30/TB,format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.16:gg=0.2:bb=0.22[dots];[soft][dots]blend=all_mode=subtract,noise=alls=2:allf=t,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 15 -c:v libx264 -crf 12 -preset veryfast work/bg.mp4

ffmpeg -i work/bg.mp4 -i work/text.mov -i work/whoosh.wav -i work/chime.wav -filter_complex "[1]format=yuva420p,split=4[s0][s1][s2][s3];[s0]trim=start=0:end=3.5,fade=t=in:st=0.15:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=3.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t0];[0][t0]overlay=y='90*pow(max(0,1-(t-0.15)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v0];[s1]trim=start=3.5:end=7.5,fade=t=in:st=3.55:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=7.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t1];[v0][t1]overlay=y='90*pow(max(0,1-(t-3.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v1];[s2]trim=start=7.5:end=11,fade=t=in:st=7.55:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=10.65:d=0.35:alpha=1[t2];[v1][t2]overlay=y='90*pow(max(0,1-(t-7.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v2];[s3]trim=start=11:end=15,fade=t=in:st=11.05:d=0.7:alpha=1[t3];[v2][t3]overlay=y='90*pow(max(0,1-(t-11.05)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v3];[v3]fade=t=in:d=0.4,fade=t=out:st=14.3:d=0.7,format=yuv420p[v];[2]asplit=3[w0][w1][w2];[w0]adelay=3250:all=1,volume=0.55[x0];[w1]adelay=7250:all=1,volume=0.55[x1];[w2]adelay=10750:all=1,volume=0.55[x2];[3]adelay=11250:all=1,volume=0.7[x3];[x0][x1][x2][x3]amix=inputs=4:normalize=0,aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo,apad,atrim=0:15,afade=t=out:st=14.3:d=0.7[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 15 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/vertical-promo.mp4
